title: Deterministic B0 swing-equation control-plane acceptance
research_question: Can a fixed classical swing-equation case pass the role-A contract, state, approval, and provenance pipeline without any LLM call?
objectives: Validate all B0 input contracts before routing
Freeze one hash-bound deterministic experiment protocol
Produce an immutable and independently verifiable Result Bundle
falsification_criteria: Reject the run if a required contract is invalid or a referenced content hash differs
Reject protocol freezing if approval does not bind the exact draft protocol hash
Reject bundle verification if any artifact payload is missing or changed

notes: This fixture validates role A only; physical simulation remains owned by roles B-D.
